camel_example: aliyun maxcompute POST /api/v1/quotas --region cn-hangzhou --commodityData 'CU_:50,_ord_time_:_1:Month_,_autoRenew_:false' --chargeType payasyougo --partNickName MyQuota --commodityCode odps --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Creates a quota. When you activate MaxCompute for the first time, you must first create a pay-as-you-go quota. If you create a subscription quota, automatic payment is deducted
description_zh: 创建Quota，首次开通MaxCompute 必须先创建后付费类型的Quota，如果创建的是预付费类型的Quota，会进行自动扣款
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute create-quota --charge-type payasyougo --commodity-data CU_:50,_ord_time_:_1:Month_,_autoRenew_:false --part-nick-name MyQuota --commodity-code odps --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateQuota

parameters.description_en: The billing method. Valid values: payasyougo (pay-as-you-go) and subscription.

parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.description_en:
The commodity specifications of the quota.

><notice>

- This parameter is required only for subscription quotas.
The minimum unit for cu is 50.
ord_time supports monthly (month) and yearly (year) billing.

- After creation, commodityData cannot be modified. To modify it, go to the MaxCompute console.

></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
配额商品规格

><notice>

- 仅在预付费(subscription)情况下需要填写
cu 最小单位为50
ord_time 支持包月(month)和包年(year)

- 创建之后 commodityData 不支持修改,如需修改请在MaxCompute控制台操作

></notice>

parameters.description_en: The commodity code. Example: On Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com), the commodity code for pay-as-you-go is odps and the commodity code for subscription is odpsplus. On Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com), the commodity code for pay-as-you-go is odps_intl and the commodity code for subscription is odpsplus_intl.
